issues.title: `GET /orders/1004` gives the wrong total
issues.body:
The customer of order 1004 paid $83.37 for 3 fountain pens and 2 notebooks. `GET /orders/1004` gives `total_cents` 5838 (`$58.38`), and `python3 -m shop order show 1004` prints `PEN-5 x2` and `total $58.38`. The lines in `data/orders.json` are correct. The handler `get_order` in `shop/api/handlers.py` gives the wrong total.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `GET /orders/1004` on the sample data gives `total_cents` 8337 and `total` `"$83.37"`.
- [ ] When an order has more than one line of the same product, the quantities of those lines add up: the lines of order 1004 give a quantity of 3 for `PEN-5`.
- [ ] An order placed through `POST /orders` with two lines of the same product has the total of both lines, also when it is read again.
- [ ] The daily report counts such an order at its full total.
